commit_message:
[sfnt] Rewrite GPOS kerning support. (2/2)

The previous code had a fundamental flaw: it didn't validate the necessary
parts of the 'GPOS' table before accessing it, causing crashes with
malformed data (since `TT_CONFIG_OPTION_GPOS_KERNING` is off by default,
standard fuzzers don't catch these problems).  Additionally, it did a lot of
parsing while accessing kerning data, making it rather slow.

The new implementation fixes this.  After validation, offsets to the 'GPOS'
lookup subtables used in the 'kern' feature that correspond to 'simple'
kerning (i.e., similar to 'kern' table kerning) are stored in `TT_Face`;
this greatly simplifies and accelerates access to the kerning data.

Testing with font `SF-Pro.ttf` version '1.00', the validation time for the
'GPOS' table increases the start-up time of `FT_New_Face` by less than 1%,
while calls to `FT_Get_Kerning` become about 3.5 times faster.

* include/freetype/internal (gpos_kerning_available): Replace with...
  (gpos_lookups_kerning, num_gpos_lookups_kerning): ... these new fields.
  Update callers.

* src/ttgpos.c [TT_CONFIG_OPTION_GPOS_KERNING]: A new implementation.

diff --git a/devel/ftoption.h b/devel/ftoption.h
index 9b22a960e..10ccf56ab 100644
--- a/devel/ftoption.h
+++ b/devel/ftoption.h
@@ -783,14 +783,14 @@ FT_BEGIN_HEADER
 
 
   /**************************************************************************
    *
    * Option `TT_CONFIG_OPTION_GPOS_KERNING` enables a basic GPOS kerning
-   * implementation (for TrueType fonts only).  With this defined, FreeType
-   * is able to get kerning pair data from the GPOS 'kern' feature as well as
-   * legacy 'kern' tables; without this defined, FreeType will only be able
-   * to use legacy 'kern' tables.
+   * implementation (for TrueType and OpenType fonts only).  With this
+   * defined, FreeType is able to get kerning pair data from the GPOS 'kern'
+   * feature as well as legacy 'kern' tables; without this defined, FreeType
+   * will only be able to use legacy 'kern' tables.
    *
    * Note that FreeType does not support more advanced GPOS layout features;
    * even the 'kern' feature implemented here doesn't handle more
    * sophisticated kerning variants.  Use a higher-level library like
    * HarfBuzz instead for that.

findings.title: Off-by-one range check causes heap-buffer-overflow read in tt_face_get_class()
findings.message: In tt_face_get_class(), when parsing a Format 1 ClassDef table for GPOS Pair Adjustment (class-based) kerning, the code validates that glyph_index falls within [startGlyphID, startGlyphID + glyphCount] using the condition `startGlyphID + glyphCount >= glyph_index`. This is an off-by-one error: the valid range for the ClassValueArray, which has exactly `glyphCount` entries indexed 0..glyphCount-1, is `[startGlyphID, startGlyphID + glyphCount)` (i.e. glyph_index must be strictly less than startGlyphID + glyphCount). Because `>=` is used instead of `>`, a glyph_index equal to startGlyphID + glyphCount is incorrectly accepted, and the subsequent `FT_PEEK_USHORT( p + ( glyph_index - startGlyphID ) * 2 )` reads two bytes starting one entry past the end of the ClassValueArray buffer. When the ClassDef1 table is located at (or near) the end of the font's memory-mapped/allocated buffer with no trailing padding, this results in a heap-buffer-overflow read, as demonstrated by a crafted TTF/OpenType font reachable via FT_Get_Kerning -> tt_face_get_gpos_kerning -> tt_face_get_pair_pos2_kerning -> tt_face_get_class.
findings.suggestion: Change the upper-bound comparison from '>=' to '>' so that glyph_index is only accepted when it is strictly less than startGlyphID + glyphCount, matching the actual size of the ClassValueArray (glyphCount entries).

ground_truth.root_cause: Incorrect boundary comparison operator (>=) used to bound-check glyph_index against startGlyphID + glyphCount, when the array being indexed has exactly glyphCount elements starting at startGlyphID, making the valid range exclusive of startGlyphID + glyphCount, i.e. a classic off-by-one/fencepost error in range validation introduced during a from-scratch rewrite of GPOS kerning support.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Off-by-one range check causes heap-buffer-overflow read in tt_face_get_class()
